name: lobster-maps
description: Privacy-first maps and navigation for Bergen, Norway. Powered by Rust/WASM routing and Material Design 3.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:server: cd server && npm run test 2>/dev/null || echo 'No server tests'
scripts.test:client: cd client && npm run test 2>/dev/null || echo 'No client tests'
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.lint:server: cd server && npm run lint 2>/dev/null || echo 'No server linter'
scripts.lint:client: cd client && npm run lint 2>/dev/null || echo 'No client linter'

author: Lobster
